request.body:
## Result and scope

Refs #178

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/178#issuecomment-6863568268, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-a112`.
- Outputs: new report directory `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C16/endpoints/ADB991-claude-20261113-a112/` (`mathematics.md`, `validation.md`). Nothing else changes.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: ADB991's account. The report was written by Claude. ADB991 authored C04 (PRs #66, #88) and C16 revision 1 (#165), so this is an author-side endpoint check, not independent approval.

Endpoint check of `C04-to-C16-reconstruction`, with C04 and C16 both at `69b2631`. Every clause of `ex-reconstructed` and `eq:public-selected-boundary` is matched to a named C04 statement, conditionally on the open C04 ledger inputs. The one exception is "at least one smeared field is nonzero". The match uses an explicit time-first → time-last transport rule (T): tests are pulled back by C(t,**x**)=(**x**,t), Λ ↦ CΛC⁻¹, and the cone and spectral measure are pushed forward. The tube direction, field order, height sign and integrability convention were checked against `ChallengeSpec.Reconstructed` and the C04 formula for F_n.

Three items remain open:
- F1: the wording of the C04 coordinate paragraph (`complex-heat.tex` l.112–116, re-review #91 issue 1) is still inaccurate. It has no effect on the endpoint. Owner: the C04 author, coordinated with PR #203.
- F2: E4 (field levels, inclusions, union) still has no producer. It also carries the identification of the public label space with the C04 union. It is stronger than the public injectivity and covering clauses, so it is not a mismatch of direction.
- F3: the nonzero-field clause. The report writes out the source route (`Table.alive` → `pin_inj` → faithful). That route needs a unit law for the limiting original table, which the manuscript does not state, and a short C04 corollary.

No C16 chapter needs to change.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. Base `codex/existence-monograph` @ `69b2631`. SHA-256 hashes of the 17 files inspected are in `validation.md`.
- Commands actually run and results: `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py` (exit 0, "Blueprint structure OK: 4 units"); `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` (22 tests OK); `git diff --cached --check` clean.
- Checks not performed and why: no LaTeX build (no `.tex` changed); no Lean elaboration (Mathlib is unreachable here), so Lean was read as source text only.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: none. The report proposes follow-ups to the C03 limits owner (unit law) and the C04 author (F1 wording and the F3 corollary).
